data.summary:
13 years of Experience in Warehousing, Operation Management, and Recruitment process
Proficiency in SAP LSMW , field mapping and data conversion techniques
Designed a custom LSMW script that improved data accuracy for customer Master records
Create internal guides on SAP Data migration best practices and increasing team efficiency
Expertise in Coordinating with teams and managing migration workflows
Effective in troubleshooting errors during migration
Migrated legacy system customer master data inti SAP ECC using LSMW
Provided training and support to end-users on SAP EWM functionalities, enhancing their ability to utilize the system effectively in daily operations
Master Data is SAP EWM is crucial for enabling and streamling in warehouse processes
Responsible for working on Warehouse activities like Inbound & outbound, Inventory Control, Internal Stack Audit, & End-to End Warehouse Activities in FMCG & FMEG Sectors.
Handling the entire Warehousing Operations,  Inventory Management & WMS Location
Coordination for Training and Development activities for team members
ORGANISATIONAL EXPERIENCE
FLYJAC LOGISTICS PVT LTD : HAVELLS INDIA LTD , COIMBATORE
Senior Executive ( Supply Chain Management )  Oct - 2024 to Dec 2024
Focused on Streamline Warehouse Operations to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
Conducting a  thorough stack audit of Inventory Management System & SAP WMS Location
Inventory Tracking System that utilized Barcode Scanning Technology and maintain Real-time visibility of stack levels
Significantly reducing the time spent on manual Counts and audits.
Ensure that the work Environment is Safe and Conduct regular safety training sessions and promote a culture of safety awareness.
Monitoring on -Time Pick & Reduce Overtime
Achieving OBD ( OUT BOUND DELIVERY ) & Gate Outperformance
Stack Accuracy & Team Skill Improvement
Using T-Code MM01, MM02,MM03 & MM17
Maintain the WMS location  ( Storage Area)
DABUR INDIA LTD  CFA ( Excel Logistics) COIMBATORE
Asst Manager /  Floor Manager ( 2019 March to 2024 April )
Stock checking, Material Movement, Sales Returns & Maintaining Inward Stocks.
Provide scheduling support and resource allocation for warehouse staff.
Conducting Stock Audit in Warehouse to update stocks in SAP.
Ensures safe working conditions including properly training employees.
Manage, monitor and maintain proper Inventory records of the movement of goods  and out of the Warehouse & End-to End Warehouse Activity.
Inventory Control Quality Assurance Operations Management Team Building & Leadership Logistics Shipping & Receiving
JOB EXPOSURE INDIA PRIVATE LTD, BANGALORE
Senior HR (Recruitment), Jan- 2014 to Nov- 2017
Responsible for Goal setting, Performance reviews and development plan.
Supervising, Monitoring, Guiding and Motivating Team.
Maintain Manpower requisition from Clients and Complete Database of Clients.
Coordinating with the HR Team for Resources Joining Formalities.
Understanding the requirements and mentor HR executives
Responsible for End to End Recruitment Process
WIPRO INFOTECH LTD  ( Easy Mate Technology ) , BANGALORE 
SAP (SD): End-User (Operational Executive) Nov 2011 to Feb 2013
Handling for Finalization of Purchase Order.
Booking order and spearheading tasks pertaining to billing and triggering in SAP.
Make recommendations and communicates findings to senior management based on analysis.
Maintaining schedules and cancellation process of application.
THRIVENI EARTH MOVERS PRIVATE LTD, (TEMPL) ORISSA, 
Marketing Officer: (Operation / logistics)  Jun 2010 to Oct 2011
Implement and monitor various Sales and Marketing activities in Mines Sector
Generating the daily and weekly report & Dispatch activities.
